scope: Parametreli araç entegrasyonu deneyi; gerçek İHA tasarım seçimi değildir.
method: Native VSPAERO potential flow plus XFOIL strip profile-drag estimate; approximate low-angle CL² rescaling
limits: No aircraft feasibility or optimum claim
No fuselage, interference, stall, propulsion, energy, trim or structural assessment
Section lift is rescaled using low-angle linearity; 2D to 3D viscous coupling is approximate
Panel convergence thresholds concern CL and CDi, not all possible outputs
